name: MySQL
description: Connect to a MySQL database and extract records from a table or custom query with offset and cursor-based pagination and incremental sync.
author: OnePlatform

database.description: Name of the MySQL database (schema) to connect to

table.description: Name of the table to extract records from. Ignored when customQuery is set.

incrementalColumn.description: Column name used for incremental sync (e.g. updated_at). When set, each run fetches only rows where this column is greater than the last cursor value.

batchSize.description: Number of rows to fetch per batch

customQuery.description: Optional SQL SELECT query. When provided, the table and incrementalColumn settings are ignored. The query must not include LIMIT or OFFSET — those are appended by the connector.

proxyUrl.description: URL of the MySQL REST proxy that executes parameterized queries on behalf of the sandbox. Required — plugins cannot open raw TCP sockets.

requiredCredentials.name: connectionString
requiredCredentials.description: MySQL connection string in the form mysql://user:password@host:port/database
